learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how sports events are organized, understand Knock-out and League fixtures, and discover how to calculate byes and seeding!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: बाई (बिना खेले अगले दौर में जाना)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Competitions are mainly divided into: Knock-out (elimination tournaments), League/Round Robin (every team plays every other team), Combination tournaments, and Challenge tournaments.

In a Knock-out tournament, a team is eliminated after a single defeat. When the number of participating teams is not a power of 2 (2, 4, 8, 16...), 'Byes' are awarded in the first round so that remaining rounds balance out.
In a League tournament, every team plays all other teams regardless of win or loss. Fixtures can be drawn using the Cyclic method or the Staircase method.

Seeding is a procedure of placing strong teams in separate halves or quarters of a fixture so they do not eliminate each other in the early rounds. Special Seeding allows top teams to enter directly into quarterfinals or semifinals.

fun_activity.title: 🎟️ Calculate the Byes!
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you are organizing a school tournament with 11 teams. Find the next highest power of 2 (2, 4, 8, 16...). Since 16 is the next power of 2, calculate 16 minus 11 = 5. You need to award exactly 5 byes in your fixture!

exam_tips: 📌 Practicing fixture drawing is mandatory! You will almost certainly be asked to draw a Knock-out fixture for 11, 13, or 19 teams showing upper/lower halves and byes.
📌 Memorize the formula for total matches in a League tournament: N(N - 1) / 2, where N is the number of teams.
📌 Differentiate clearly between a regular 'Bye' and 'Special Seeding'.
quick_recap: ⭐ League tournaments are considered the most fair because a single bad day does not eliminate a deserving team.
⭐ Intramural competitions are held within the walls of an institution, while Extramural competitions are between different institutions.
⭐ Proper planning by specialized committees (reception, logistics, technical) is essential for a successful sports tournament.
